title: Add wc_crypto2dev_pool_stats and wc_crypto2dev_selftest APIs
description: Add two public functions: wc_crypto2dev_pool_stats(in_use, total) for runtime pool utilization, and wc_crypto2dev_selftest() that runs a NIST AES-128-GCM KAT to verify the device is alive. Lets callers distinguish pool exhaustion from device failure after WC_HW_E.
